title: ARSIA Capability Descriptor
description: Describes a single capability exposed by an ARSIA agent. Returned as an element of the JSON array from the capability discovery endpoint (GET /.well-known/arsia/capabilities). Defined in ARSIA-Core.md §7.2. Distinct from ActionDescriptor (ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1) — a capability descriptor provides protocol-level metadata about a capability (risk, oversight, prerequisites), while an ActionDescriptor defines a business action's full compliance obligations.

allOf.description: The capability identifier string using dot-separated reverse domain notation with at least two segments. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.2.

description.description: Human-readable description of the capability. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.2.

risk_level.description: Risk level from 0 (no risk) to 10 (critical). Informs compliance decisions: 0–2 low, 3–5 medium, 6–8 high, 9–10 critical. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.2.

human_oversight_required.description: Whether the receiving agent will require human approval via pending_approval/approval_decision intents before executing this capability, regardless of compliance profile. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.2.

rate_limit.description: Per-capability rate limit in requests per minute. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.2.

requires.description: Array of prerequisite capability strings that MUST also be present in the request's capabilities array when this capability is invoked. Per ARSIA-Core.md §7.2.
